hook_text: 125 learners, minibuses of 15. The sum says 8 remainder 5. Five kids are standing at the gate.
clip_script: School outing in Rustenburg. 125 learners, minibuses that seat 15. 125 divided by 15: 15 times 8 is 120, 5 left. 8 remainder 5. Write that down and five learners watch the buses drive away. Everyone must travel, so round up: 9 minibuses. Same sum, different story: 125 sweets in bags of 15 to sell. 8 full bags. The 5 loose sweets do not make a bag, so round down: 8. Same remainder, opposite decision. Now the rate: 480 kilometres in 6 hours. Divide to find one hour: 80 kilometres per hour. And sharing R100 in the ratio 3 to 2: five parts, R20 a part, so R60 and R40. Divide first. Then read the story again. The story decides what the leftover means.
visual_style: Whiteboard minibuses filling up with five stick figures left at a gate, then a ninth bus appearing; bags of sweets with five loose ones; blocks of a ratio.
mood: Story-driven with a small moment of alarm at the gate.
pacing: The remainder dilemma both ways, then the rate and the ratio share, then the rule.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out how many cars your class would need for a trip.
